text:
Asha: Posted IO cache eviction postmortem — https://redwood.internal/postmortems/io-cache-2026. We need concrete follow-ups: repro/regression, promptset additions, sustained load, and a chaos drill.

Ben: Ill take the deterministic replay harness (replay traces -> validate eviction ordering). Plan: PR + CI job + nightly. ETA ~10d.

Lili: I'll own promptsets and evals. Two sets (short/long context) + latency correctness checks. Acceptance: P95 <= 1.3x, accuracy delta < 1%. ETA 7d.

Marco: Infra: Ill export and scrub two incident traces and provision staging signals for a single controlled eviction run. Scrub ETA 48h. Also will request a temporary quota bump for the 90m run.

ops-bot: Created PERF-5123 "eviction-tests-and-load-90m" linked to IO-CACHE-2026. CI template `eviction-suite-nightly` available.

Asha: Suggested test filenames & labels for discoverability:
```
tests/eviction/
  - eviction_replay.yaml    # deterministic replay
  - eviction_90m_sustained.yaml  # sustained working-set ramp
labels: ["regression","eviction","kv","chaos"]
```

Ben: Will include a small local-run README and sample sanitized trace references in the PR.

Lili: I'll add eval-runner jobs `eviction/latency` and `eviction/correctness` and commit golden baselines.

Asha: Owners recap: Ben (harness), Lili (promptsets+evals), Marco (traces+infra), Asha (tabletop + follow-up). Checklist in PERF-5123. Everyone drop firm ETAs in the ticket by EOD. :thumbsup:
